schema: Accenture Context-Aware Analyst Feedback Learning Contract Specification
organization: Accenture Decision Intelligence Platform / Signal Story
description: Defines deterministic, bounded, context-aware analyst feedback learning for driver prioritization, preserving underlying evidence scores and safety governance.

governance_rules.evidence_immutability: Feedback adjustment NEVER modifies the frozen analytical core, raw evidence scores, or ground truth files.
governance_rules.prioritization_only: Feedback only influences the final composite driver prioritization ranking: feedback_adjusted_score = clamp(base_score + feedback_adjustment, 0.0, 1.0).
governance_rules.bounded_adjustment: The net cumulative feedback adjustment for any driver in a given context is strictly clamped between min_adjustment and max_adjustment (±0.15).
governance_rules.context_isolation: Feedback applied in one market/product context decays to 0.0 for unrelated contexts, preventing cross-scenario contamination.
governance_rules.safety_authority: Safety governance (guardrails, contradictions, anomaly validity) remains strictly authoritative over feedback-adjusted rankings.
